method: corpus-blind controlled generator; 38 practical/natural/physical cross-domain cases

cases.knowledge_need: How a cold hearthstone, uneven coals, and a damp loaf surface affect whether bread cooks through without burning its crust.
cases.circumstances: rain began while the oven was being heated
cases.situation: She has one batch of dough ready before neighbors need the oven.

cases.knowledge_need: How cream temperature and the rhythm of churning affect butter separating instead of remaining thin and foamy.
cases.circumstances: morning cream stood near a cool stone wall
cases.situation: He must prepare butter before the family leaves for market.

cases.knowledge_need: How a smokehouse fire that flares instead of smolders can heat meat too strongly and create a fire risk.
cases.circumstances: dry wood was added after a wet night
cases.situation: She sees flames licking toward hanging sausages.

cases.knowledge_need: How grain that is too damp or too dry changes grinding and can clog or scatter at hand millstones.
cases.circumstances: a sack came in from foggy weather
cases.situation: He needs flour for supper without wasting the stored grain.

cases.knowledge_need: How a cracked eggshell and warm storage change the chance that an egg remains usable for cooking.
cases.circumstances: a basket was bumped while being carried indoors
cases.situation: She must choose ingredients for food served to several people.

cases.knowledge_need: How a covered water jar set in shade differs from one left in direct sun when keeping drawn water cool and clean.
cases.circumstances: the day turns hot before noon
cases.situation: Children will return thirsty from field work.

cases.knowledge_need: How hard rubbing on a rough board can thin wet linen at seams and edges while trying to remove a stubborn stain.
cases.circumstances: a shirt was stained with garden soil
cases.situation: She wants it clean without turning a small stain into a tear.

cases.knowledge_need: How uneven wetting and overheating affect color uptake when wool is dyed in a plant-based bath.
cases.circumstances: the fire has begun burning hotter on one side
cases.situation: He needs a usable even color for a customer's cloth.

cases.knowledge_need: How pulling a linen thread too tight through dry leather can pucker a repaired pouch and reopen holes.
cases.circumstances: a pouch seam split during a wet journey
cases.situation: She must carry small goods again before dawn.

cases.knowledge_need: How carving across changing grain in a green wooden spoon blank can cause a knife to split off more wood than intended.
cases.circumstances: the blank was cut from fresh birch
cases.situation: He needs to shape a bowl without cutting into his supporting hand.

cases.knowledge_need: How levering a bent iron nail from a thin board can split the board when force is applied without support.
cases.circumstances: a loose shutter must be rehung
cases.situation: She has only one sound board left for the repair.

cases.knowledge_need: How a loose hearthstone can shift under a hot pot and why a fresh clay packing needs time before strong heat.
cases.circumstances: one cooking stone rocked while ashes were cleared
cases.situation: He must make breakfast without spilling boiling food into the fire.

cases.knowledge_need: How soft ground, a wet ladder foot, and reaching sideways change the stability of a ladder against a wall.
cases.circumstances: overnight rain darkened the soil
cases.situation: She needs to reach a high shelf before moving baskets inside.

cases.knowledge_need: How a dry wooden wheel and a loosened iron tire can change when a loaded cart crosses rough stones.
cases.circumstances: a long dry spell followed a wet spring
cases.situation: He hears a new rattle with cargo still aboard.

cases.knowledge_need: How a knot tightened under load can jam and how a slick wet rope can loosen on a moving bundle.
cases.circumstances: rain has soaked the hemp cord
cases.situation: She must secure sacks for a short boat crossing.

cases.knowledge_need: How letting a hot working horse drink deeply at once from very cold water can affect its comfort and ability to continue.
cases.circumstances: the horse climbed a long hill in warm weather
cases.situation: He must rest it before continuing with a message.

cases.knowledge_need: How a narrow coop opening and a startled hen can make collecting eggs risky when another bird is brooding nearby.
cases.circumstances: a dog ran past the enclosure
cases.situation: She needs eggs but does not want to injure birds or break them.

cases.knowledge_need: How wet fleece, a restless animal, and dull shears increase pulling and cut risk during shearing.
cases.circumstances: a shower ended shortly before work began
cases.situation: He must decide whether to continue with animals waiting.

cases.knowledge_need: How a dog guarding food responds differently to direct approach, sudden movement, and giving it space.
cases.circumstances: an inn dog has taken a bone beside the gate
cases.situation: She needs to pass with a child without escalating the animal's warning.

cases.knowledge_need: How closing a stable tightly against cold can trap damp air and fumes around animals and bedding.
cases.circumstances: wind-driven snow enters through a cracked shutter
cases.situation: He wants warmth overnight without making the animals cough or bedding stay wet.

cases.knowledge_need: How soaking soil deeply at a plant's roots differs from frequent shallow sprinkling during a dry spell.
cases.circumstances: three cloudless days have dried the surface
cases.situation: She has limited water carried from a nearby well.

cases.knowledge_need: How storing seeds before they are fully dry can lead to heating, mold, or poor germination later.
cases.circumstances: rainy weather forced harvested seed heads indoors
cases.situation: He must save enough sound seed for next spring.

cases.knowledge_need: How age, damage, and uncertain identification make wild mushrooms unsafe even when they resemble familiar edible kinds.
cases.circumstances: several caps were bruised in a basket
cases.situation: She plans supper for a family and wants to avoid a harmful mistake.

cases.knowledge_need: How a thorny hedge branch under tension can spring back when cut and strike eyes or hands.
cases.circumstances: new growth has tangled around old dead stems
cases.situation: He must open a passage before a cart comes through.

cases.knowledge_need: How dry leaf litter, wind, and an unattended cooking ember can spread fire faster than expected along a forest floor.
cases.circumstances: afternoon wind rises after a dry week
cases.situation: She notices an ember blown beyond the fire ring before packing to leave.

cases.knowledge_need: How a grass-covered bog edge can look firm while waterlogged turf gives way under a person's weight.
cases.circumstances: recent rain raised water between sedges
cases.situation: He must reach a bundle without stepping into hidden soft ground.

cases.knowledge_need: How freeze-thaw cracks and loose stones above a narrow path create danger after a cold night and bright morning.
cases.circumstances: water dripped from the slope during yesterday's thaw
cases.situation: She hears small stones moving while leading a laden mule.

cases.knowledge_need: How damp clothing and strong wind remove body heat faster than calm cold air and affect a person's ability to work safely.
cases.circumstances: a cold wind follows a short rain shower
cases.situation: He begins shivering while waiting for a boat to return.

cases.knowledge_need: How shade, head covering, and rest affect heat strain during long work beside reflective pale sand.
cases.circumstances: midday sun is bright and wind is still
cases.situation: She feels headache after carrying several baskets.

cases.knowledge_need: How a shallow ditch, an isolated tree, and a low group of shrubs differ as places to wait during nearby lightning.
cases.circumstances: lightning flashes before rain begins
cases.situation: He must keep himself and animals from the most exposed ground.

cases.knowledge_need: How a floating branch caught in a swift current can pull a person off balance if used as a handhold near shore.
cases.circumstances: water rose after distant rain
cases.situation: She wants to retrieve a net line tangled near the edge.

cases.knowledge_need: How passengers shifting together and cargo placed high can make a small rowboat roll suddenly when a wake reaches it.
cases.circumstances: another boat passes close in choppy weather
cases.situation: He carries a basket and must help keep the boat steady.

cases.knowledge_need: How blocked ventilation in a snow-covered shelter can make a warming fire or lamp dangerous despite protection from wind.
cases.circumstances: blowing snow has covered the entrance gaps
cases.situation: Two people seek warmth before continuing at daylight.

cases.knowledge_need: How clear ice near a shore can weaken from warming water below before the surface visibly changes.
cases.circumstances: several mild days follow a hard freeze
cases.situation: She considers crossing a short section to save time with a bundle.

cases.knowledge_need: How smoke used to drive insects away can irritate eyes and lungs when wind carries it into a low shelter.
cases.circumstances: mosquitoes rise at dusk and air is still
cases.situation: He wants relief without filling the sleeping space with smoke.

cases.knowledge_need: How a cloth wrapped over a shallow cut differs from pressing directly on a deeper bleeding wound while seeking help.
cases.circumstances: a sickle slipped while cutting grain
cases.situation: She needs to control bleeding without returning dirt to the wound.

cases.knowledge_need: How cooling a fresh minor burn with clean cool water differs from applying grease or rubbing damaged skin.
cases.circumstances: a pot handle shifted while being lifted
cases.situation: He has burned fingers and still needs to keep others safe from the fire.

cases.knowledge_need: How layering dry bedding beneath a sleeper differs from adding only blankets above when ground is cold and damp.
cases.circumstances: rain soaked the yard before a cold night
cases.situation: She must settle a child with limited dry cloth and straw.
